purpose: Offline and loopback-only CI snapshot verification fixtures
derivation: The public GitHub observations were reduced to the fields exercised by the snapshot verifier. PR title, body, actors and unrelated repository metadata were removed. Original public ci-event ZIP bytes, workflow bytes, pagination links and GraphQL check observations are retained for authentication and replay; the outer fixture ZIP has deterministic timestamps. The fixture is immutable input to local tests and does not access the original historical paths or GitHub.
secret_check: A static scan of every fixture member found no GitHub token pattern, bearer authorization header, private-key marker, or common signed-URL signature parameter. This scan is limited to those patterns.
